# Integration Hub Beta (Rust)

> A Rust rewrite of the NHS Wales Integration Hub: it receives HL7 v2
> clinical messages from hospital systems, validates and transforms them, and
> delivers them to the Master Patient Index and other destinations. Work in
> progress; the Python it replaces is what runs today. `spec/` is the source
> of truth; code and tests follow it.

Rules that apply to every task: patient data never reaches a log; a message
is never acknowledged unless it was delivered; the gate is `cargo xtask gate`
(never `cargo fmt --all`: use `cargo xtask fmt`).

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the rules every task follows, and the gate
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): what is specific to working here interactively
- [index.md](index.md): every document and when to read it
- [spec/index.md](spec/index.md): the normative specification
- [tasks.md](tasks.md): what is done and what is next
- [plan.md](plan.md): the plan, and the deliberate deviations from the Python
